panels.html:
Mechanical Guardians

Doryani's Science

Non-Unique Strongboxes are guarded by a dormant Construct These Strongboxes only roll Modifiers which apply to the Construct Opening the Strongbox activates the Construct

Strongboxes have 2% increased Item Quantity per Modifier

Their creators are long since dust, but their duty remains.
